synopsis: Upon awakening, a little girl named Lezay finds herself standing alone in an unfamiliar meadow. In front stands a massive dog. Such a creature had never been seen near home before. At that moment, a conclusion forms that this must be what is called reincarnation into another world. Soon, a band of muscular mercenaries appears, seemingly on a mission to subdue the giant dog. However, it turns out this dog is no ordinary beast, but a divine beast. The divine beast, Ranag, becomes deeply attached to Lezay, the only one it can communicate with. In response, leader Alragia offers to take both Lezay and Ranag under the protection of the mercenary troop...? A little girl, a divine dog, and a mercenary squad. This is a bizarre off-world fantasy with some strange members! (Source: Alpha Manga)

Rin's parents passed away when she was little and she has been living with her brother ever since, caring for the family shrine. One day, she meets a transfer student, Suo Kusa. He kisses the birthmark on her neck as he exclaims "I finally found you...!" Suo tells her that they're childhood friends and he moved back to town to see her, but she doesn't remember anything. Then she ends up witnessing his true form... that of a demon! "It's your fate to become my wife!" he whispers as he pulls her close... (Source: Renta!) title: Hyang-Dan Dyeon
titleNative: 향단뎐
synopsis: Job seeker Yu Hyang-Gi, struggling day by day, one day finds herself possessed by Hyang-Dan, the character from the traditional Korean folktale Chunhyangjeon. A supporting character, not even the heroine? How wonderful! Our beautiful young lady Chunhyang, and even a madam who cares for her like her own daughter. Hyang-Dan, who only felt the warmth of family after being possessed by the novel, was enjoying a peaceful life. Until "him" showed up! The world's ultimate villain, Byun Hak-Do, is destined to harass Chunhyang and be executed by the male protagonist, Lee Mong-Ryong. How dare he look down on our Chunhyang! "I don't know who you are, but you're a brat." "I've been waiting." "That's why I'm offering you this. An honor no one else can attain." But why do you keep entangling yourself with me? Why does that man care more about me than Chunhyang? A romantic fantasy about Hyang-Dan and Byeon Hak-Do, a twist on classic novels, Hyangdan's Tale. (Source: Kakaopage, translated)
